title: starRating widget does not hide when no data
body:
All filtering widgets are hidden when there's no data to be shown.
The starRating widget does not. Instead, when no results contain any rating value (ie. everything is `null`), all stars choices are showing, grayed out.

It is a bit confusing when everything else disappears and only this stays in, but unusable.

There should probably at least be an option to have the same behavior.
